annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados, Dep. Lucio Mosquini
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds Art. 36-E to Law 9.394/1996 making AI education a curricular component of subsequent technical vocational courses.
AI education focuses on digital literacy, computing, programming, robotics and digital skills.
Education systems have one year to regulate and implement.
Justification stresses labour market demand, competitiveness and sustainable development.
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill PL 357/2024 amends the national education guidelines law (LDB) to include artificial intelligence education, covering digital literacy, programming and robotics, in subsequent technical vocational courses. The justification stresses workforce demand, competitiveness and sustainable development.
annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 357/2024 - Altera a Lei nº 9.394/1996 para dispor sobre a inclusão das atividades de Inteligência Artificial como ensino técnico profissionalizante
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 357/2024 - Amends Law 9.394/1996 to include Artificial Intelligence activities as vocational technical education
